comments.body: Hi! I can take a look at this and work on removing the obsolete version check and delay.
Err. I'm not a member of this org.

This is more complex than it appears to be.

Technically this check and magic number cannot be removed because someone can upgrade their Temporal cluster from a very old version (not doing the GetNamespaceCacheRefreshInterval local activity) to the latest version while the reclaim resource workflow is running. Then removing the logic will be a non-deterministic change. 

Even if they are in a relatively newer version, the `workflow.GetVersion` call still inserts a marker into workflow history and I am not 100% sure if removing that counts as a non-deterministic change. 

If we ignore the first case (upgrading from very old Temporal version), what we could do is:
- Remove the magic number
- Keep the workflow.GetVersion() call
- But not really use the GetVersion result (i.e. remove the if statement and always call the local activity)
If that's the case, then might I suggest fixing the comment?

title: remove version check and 9s const after v1.27 release
